answer_2.quote: We re-evaluate the performance of 18 types of automatic evaluation metrics on dialogue summarization.

answer_3.quote: BARTScore treats evaluation as a nature language generation task and assumes that when the quality of generated text is better, the conditional language model has a higher probability of generating it from the source text or the reference. ... BERTScore measures the soft‑overlap between two texts at token level using contextual embeddings from BERT.

answer_4.quote: We perform human evaluation in four aspects, as in: Coherence, Consistency, Fluency, Relevance. ... We recruited annotators from the school forum ... each summary was evaluated by 5 different annotators ... using a Likert scale from 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated summary on a 1–5 Likert scale for four dimensions: Coherence, Consistency, Fluency, Relevance.
